id: title:jonmcwest:mask klog headers so patterns survive past midnight

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a new regex rule and tests for Kubernetes-style log redaction, potentially improving PII handling and query performance for users relying on this shared redaction engine.
review.reason: The change adds a new regex rule ('klogtime') and its corresponding regression tests to a shared log-redaction engine. This expands the engine's capability to recognize and redact Kubernetes-style structured logs, which could benefit PostHog users who ingest such logs, improving privacy compliance and potentially downstream query performance. The implementation and tests are narrow
review.uncertainty: The actual adoption and benefit depend on whether PostHog users rely on this specific redaction engine and the compatibility of their existing logs with the new rule; no production metrics or incident avoidance are demonstrated.

observations.behavior: Adds a new regex rule named klogtime, version 3, with four severity-specific patterns and corresponding replacement strings.

This could help PostHog correctly redact Kubernetes-style structured logs without retaining sensitive timestamps or other PII, potentially improving downstream query performance and privacy compliance.
